svg.title: I-ITSM | Incident history, collaboration and supporting records

g.text: I-ITSM | Incident history, collaboration and supporting records
+send(id: long, expectedTechnicianId: long, body: String, sourceNotificationId: Long) : void
Chat uses JdbcTemplate and incident_chat_messages; there is no ChatMessage JPA entity.
IncidentNote covers notes and information requests. AuditLog is the history entity.
EmailMessage stores a recipient string, not a User foreign key.
Nullable multiplicities follow JPA optional defaults; services enforce stronger business rules.
Solid hollow triangle: inheritance | Dashed hollow triangle: interface realization
Filled diamond: composition | Hollow diamond: shared aggregation
Arrow: stored association | Dashed arrow: dependency
Source snapshot: 22 November 2026 | com.iitsm backend | Explicit members; generated accessors omitted
